name: ZEP 520A Spin Coating (400 nm)
body:
Spin coat:
1. No spreading step 
2. 3000 rpm with 1000 acceleration
3. Spin coat for 60 sec
4. 0 rpm in 5 seconds

Bake:
180°C for 3 min.

Discharge:
1. Cool down for 1 min
2. Dispense Discharge H2O (make sure there is no bubble and cover the entire chip)
3. No spreading step
4. 3000 rpm with 5000 acceleration
5. 0 rpm in 5 sec

Results:
600 nm

history.note: Duplicated from ZEP 520A Spin Coating v1
